name: Madikeri
tagline: The district town on the ridge, with the fort and the market
description: Coorg's administrative centre, strung along a ridge at around 1,200m with the old fort, the Raja's tombs, the bus stand and the district's only real shopping. It is the one place with banks, a hospital and reliable connectivity, and it is where most short stays are based.
bestFor: Anyone who needs services, a hospital and the most dependable internet in the district
pros: Banks, market and hospital all in one place
Bus connections to Bangalore, Mysore and Mangalore
cons: Congested and noisy for a hill town
Weekend tourist traffic clogs the ridge road
Little of the estate scenery people come for

name: Virajpet and the Southern Estates
tagline: Coffee country proper, homestays among the plantations
description: The southern half of the district around Virajpet, where the coffee estates run under shade trees and homestays occupy the planters' bungalows. This is what people mean by Coorg: mist, birdsong, pepper vines on the trees and no town within twenty minutes.
bestFor: Long stays that want the plantation and are prepared for the isolation
pros: Homestays with cooking and estate walks
Very low long-stay rates outside the season
cons: Connectivity is unreliable and often slow
A vehicle is essential for anything
Elephants move through the estates and are a real hazard

name: Kushalnagar and Bylakuppe
tagline: The northern town and the Tibetan settlement beside it
description: The district's other town, on the Cauvery in the lower and drier north, next to Bylakuppe, one of the largest Tibetan settlements in India with substantial monasteries including the Golden Temple. It is flatter, warmer and cheaper than Madikeri and has a very different character.
bestFor: Stays that want a working town, the monasteries and lower prices
pros: The Tibetan monasteries and their food nearby
Cheaper and better connected than the estates
On the main road to Mysore and Bangalore
cons: Warmer and less scenic than the high estates
An ordinary Indian town rather than a hill retreat
Traffic on the highway through it

name: Tadiandamol and the Southern Hills
tagline: Around Coorg's highest peak, walking country
description: The upland area in the south of the district below Tadiandamol, Coorg's highest peak at 1,748m, with the Nalknad palace nearby and trekking routes climbing through shola forest and grassland. Accommodation is scattered estate stays and homestays with nothing else around.
bestFor: Stays built entirely around walking, with everything else accepted as a compromise
pros: Coorg's highest peak and its trails on the doorstep
Cool nights and the best views in the district
cons: An hour from Madikeri on mountain roads
No shops, restaurants or services at all

name: Abbey Falls and the Madikeri Estates
tagline: Estate country just outside the town
description: The estates in the hills immediately around Madikeri, including the valley holding Abbey Falls, which lets you have the plantation setting while keeping the town ten or fifteen minutes away. It is the practical compromise between the isolation of the deep estates and the noise of the ridge.
bestFor: The best balance of estate scenery and being able to reach a shop
pros: Coffee estate setting with the town close by
Abbey Falls and estate walks nearby
Better connectivity than the deep estates
cons: Heavy weekend visitor traffic to the falls
